environment.description: Same Flask application deployed on ECS Fargate behind ALB. The task runs with a read-only root filesystem (readonlyRootFilesystem: true in task definition) with /var/data mounted as an EFS volume. The EFS access point is configured with POSIX uid:gid 1000:1000 and root directory /app-data with permissions 0755. The container runs as non-root user (uid 65534, 'nobody'). The EFS file system policy enforces aws:SecureTransport and denies root access. Additionally, the EFS mount target security group only allows NFS (2049) from the Fargate task security group.

config.alb: internet-facing, default forwarding rule, no WAF attached
